recovery_description: Reset the password with the Recovery Secret from your deployment.

sessions_revoked: Sign in again with the new password.
recovery_rejected_description: Check the value and try again.
media_page_description: Images referenced by Drafts and Publications.
media_accepted_rules: JPEG · PNG · WebP · AVIF — max 8 MiB, max 8192 px per side, max 8,388,608 px total.
media_not_accepted_rules: SVG, GIF, PDF, audio, video, or other attachments.
unable_to_manage_assets_description: The upload or media library request failed. Please retry.
asset_cleanup_completed_description: The media entry and its stored object are no longer available.
asset_became_referenced_description: Cleanup did not begin. Remove every current Draft usage and every retained Publication reference before trying again.
asset_cleanup_needs_retry_description: The Asset remains visibly pending after a storage failure. Retry the explicit cleanup action; do not attach it to new content.
no_images_yet_description: Upload your first image here, or straight from the editor when you insert a figure.
upload_limits_note: Limits: 8 MiB per file · 8192 px per side · 8,388,608 px total. SVG, GIF, PDF, audio, video and other attachments are rejected before upload.
gallery_close_hint: Click outside or press Esc to close
preview_unavailable_cleanup_pending: Preview unavailable while cleanup is pending
cleanup_failed_body: References were cleared, but the storage delete call failed. The asset stays listed — retry when storage recovers.
cleanup_queued_body: The storage worker is removing the file. This can take a moment on object storage.
referenced_cleanup_blocked_body: Cleanup is only possible when Draft refs and Publication refs are both zero. {referenceStatus}.
no_references_body: Zero Draft refs, zero Publication refs. This asset can be cleaned up — the file is removed and cannot be recovered.
cleanup_confirmation_body: Removes the stored file and media entry. This cannot be undone.
alt_not_stored_on_asset: Alt text and captions are set wherever the image is inserted — not on the asset itself.
asset_reference_status_none: No current Draft or retained Publication references
asset_authoring_intro: Choose an image, then set alt text for this use.
upload_format_limit: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF · up to 8 MiB.
decorative_figure_empty_alt: Decorative figure (saved with empty alternative text)
caption: Caption
image_upload_verify_failed: The image could not be uploaded.
select_asset_and_cover_alt: Select an Asset and enter meaningful cover alternative text.
select_asset_and_describe_figure: Select an Asset and describe the figure, or mark it decorative.
trash_moved_description: It left the normal list. Restore leaves it unpublished.
trash_page_description: Restore or permanently delete trashed articles.
trash_purge_error_description: Delete did not finish. The Article is still in Trash. You can retry.
trash_purge_point_content: The Article, its Draft and all Publications are permanently deleted.
trash_purge_point_media: Media files are not deleted — their references are released.
trash_purge_point_tombstone: Formerly public slugs keep a permanent tombstone: they answer 410 Gone and can never be reused by another article.
trash_purge_warning: {title} will be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
trash_purged_description: The article, its Draft and all Publications are gone. Media files were not touched. Formerly public slugs answer 410 Gone and cannot be reused.
trash_restore_body: Restore {title}? It returns unpublished — publish again to make it public.
trash_restore_error_description: Restore did not finish. The Article is still in Trash. Reload and try again.
trash_restored_description: Back in the list as unpublished.
settings_drawer_description: Public content defaults — Articles inherit these unless they override them.
unable_load_settings_description: Refresh the page to try again.
settings_fields_need_attention_descripti: Nothing was saved. Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
couldnt_save_settings_description: The request failed. Your edits are still in the form — retry to send them again.
settings_saved_description: New defaults apply to Articles that inherit them. Articles with overrides are unchanged.
default_public_identity_description: Shown alongside published content. Articles may override any of these per Article.
public_content_note: These values describe public content. They are unrelated to the administrator sign-in email in Account.
account_drawer_description: The single administrator — no other users, roles, or invitations by design.
admin_email_note: Fixed at initialization. This address only signs you in — the public Byline lives in Site Settings.
change_password_description: After a successful change, every existing session is revoked — including this one — and you return to the sign-in page.
unable_change_password_description: Check the current password and new password, then try again.
password_updated_description: All sessions — including this one — have been revoked. Sign in again with the new password.
sign_out_this_session_description: Ends the current browser session only. MFA is not available in this version.
password_updated_notice: Password updated. All sessions were revoked — sign in with the new password.
invalid_byline_url: Use an HTTP or HTTPS URL.
invalid_default_language: Use a valid BCP 47 language tag, such as en or zh-Hans.
tags_hint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
slug_manual_hint: Manually set — Title changes won't change it.
danger_unpublish_description: Take the live version down. Draft and history stay.
trash_disabled_not_server_confirmed: Draft changes must be saved and server-confirmed before moving to Trash
public_no_articles: No articles have been published yet.
public_how_it_works_note: Each article lives as an editable draft alongside a history of immutable publications.
public_spec_draft_body: A working copy you can revise at any time
public_article_unavailable_body: This article does not exist, or it is not currently published.
alert_article_restored_unpublished_descr: Its Draft and Publication history are intact. It has no Current Publication and remains unavailable from public endpoints until you explicitly publish it again.
alert_unable_move_to_trash: Unable to move Article to Trash
alert_unable_move_to_trash_description: Briefly did not confirm the transition. The prior Article and public visibility state remain authoritative; reload and try again.
alert_unsaved_local_changes_description: Leaving now discards changes that the server has not confirmed.
alert_draft_save_failed_description: Your current-tab changes are still available but are not durable.
alert_draft_conflict_description: A newer Draft Version is already saved. No automatic rich-text merge or overwrite was attempted.
alert_slug_claimed_description: Another Article owns this slug. Your local Draft remains visible; choose a different slug to resume autosave.
alert_offline_draft_not_saved_descriptio: Changes remain only in this tab. Briefly does not promise offline durability or synchronization. Reconnect, then retry.
alert_copy_preserved_draft_json: Copy the preserved local Draft JSON
alert_article_republished_description: The new immutable Publication is public now; earlier Publications remain unchanged.
alert_article_published_description: A new immutable Publication is public now.
alert_publication_receipt: Current Publication {publicationId} was confirmed from saved Draft Version {draftVersion}.
alert_publication_conflict_reconciled: The saved Draft Version or observed Current Publication changed. Briefly did not retry the command. Briefly reread the authoritative Article and public state. Review the refreshed state before publishing again.
alert_publication_conflict_unreconciled: The saved Draft Version or observed Current Publication changed. Briefly did not retry the command. Briefly could not fully reread the authoritative Article and public state. Reload it before publishing again.
alert_publication_not_completed_descript: The server confirmed that this Publish command made no public change. Briefly will not retry it automatically.
alert_checking_publication_state_descrip: The Publish command is not being repeated. Briefly is rereading the Article and its public state.
alert_publish_outcome_reconciled: Briefly reread the Article and its public endpoint. Review the refreshed Current Publication before issuing another Publish command.
alert_publish_outcome_unreconciled: Briefly could not fully reread the Article and public endpoint. Reload the authoritative Article state before issuing another Publish command.
alert_unable_to_publish_description: Briefly could not classify this failure safely. Reload the Article state before trying another command.
alert_article_unpublished_description: This Article is private now: it has no Current Publication and is unavailable from public content endpoints. Its Draft and Publication history remain intact, and it can be published again.
alert_unable_to_unpublish_description: Briefly did not confirm withdrawal. The existing Current Publication remains public; reload and try again.
restoring_publication_paused: Restoring Publication… Draft editing is temporarily paused.
moving_to_trash_paused: Moving Article to Trash… Draft editing is temporarily paused.
restoring_from_trash_paused: Restoring Article from Trash… Draft editing is temporarily paused.
article_unavailable_description: The Article may have moved to Trash, or the request failed.
republish_saved_draft_body: Republish saved Draft Version {version} as a new immutable Publication. Earlier Publications remain unchanged, and the Current Publication switches only after the new public read is available.
publish_saved_draft_body: Publish saved Draft Version {version} as a new immutable Publication. It will be immediately public after the Current Publication switches.
unpublish_article_body: Unpublish is reversible. It immediately removes the Current Publication from the public list and makes public detail GET and HEAD return 404. Draft and Publication history remain intact, so you can edit and publish a new immutable Publication later. This is not Trash or permanent purge, and previously published media remains public.
move_article_to_trash_body: Move {title} to Trash? This reversible action removes it from normal administration and public Article list and detail endpoints immediately. If it is public, its Current Publication is cleared. Its Draft, retained Publications, slug claims, and Asset references stay intact. Restoring it leaves it unpublished. This is not permanent purge, and previously published media remains public.
rail_draft_ahead: The Draft is ahead; live content is unchanged.
rail_not_public_yet: Not public — nothing is live yet.
rail_publishing_footnote: Publishing is available only for a server-confirmed Draft Version. Republishing creates a new immutable Publication; earlier history is preserved.
unpublished_changes_description: The Draft is ahead of the Current Publication.
no_publications_yet_description: This Article has no retained Publications yet.
publication_restored_into_draft_descript: Draft Version advanced. Preview it privately, then publish only when it is ready to replace the Current Publication.
draft_changed_before_restore_description: Reload the latest server-confirmed Draft and Publication History; no historical source was changed.
unable_restore_publication_description: The current Draft and public output were not confirmed as changed. Reload and try again.
restore_replaces_draft_footnote: Restoring replaces the current Draft. The live Publication stays until you publish again.
restore_publication_body_with_changes: This Article has unpublished Draft changes. Restoring this immutable source permanently replaces them with a new Draft Version. The selected Publication, Current Publication, public timestamps, and anonymous output remain unchanged.
restore_publication_body: Restoring this immutable source replaces the current Draft with a new Draft Version. The selected Publication, Current Publication, public timestamps, and anonymous output remain unchanged.
draft_preview_description: Renders the server-confirmed Draft only — never unsaved keystrokes.
saved_draft_version_changed_description: Reload the Article before requesting another preview.
unable_load_saved_draft_preview: Unable to load saved Draft preview
showing_saved_draft_preview: Showing saved Draft Version {draftVersion} with Renderer Version {rendererVersion}.
link_panel_description: Only absolute HTTP, HTTPS, and mailto links are allowed.
link_error_absolute: Use an absolute HTTP, HTTPS, or mailto link.
code_block_panel_description: Insert or update a code block with a syntax-highlighting language.
language_identifier_error: Use a short language identifier beginning with a letter or number.
video_panel_description: Only YouTube and Bilibili are supported. Paste a URL or video ID — never raw iframe HTML. Structured recognition extracts the platform and identifier; query parameters and iframe privileges are never stored.
video_paste_url_not_html: Paste a video URL or identifier, not iframe or HTML markup.
video_unsupported: This is not a supported YouTube or Bilibili URL or identifier. Keep unsupported providers as ordinary links.
video_recognize_failed: The video provider could not be recognized. Please retry.
video_recognize_before_insert: Recognize a supported provider before inserting the video.
video_title_required_before_insert: Enter an understandable iframe title before inserting.
video_embed_inserted: Structured video embed inserted into the Draft.
video_embed_removed: Video embed removed from the Draft.
video_title_placeholder: Brief description of the video content
video_title_a11y_note: Names the embedded player for screen readers. This title is required for accessibility.

pub_issue_unavailable: A referenced Publication resource is unavailable.

draft_issue_cover_asset: A cover must reference an existing internal Asset.
draft_issue_cover_alt: A cover requires meaningful alternative text.

draft_issue_slug_or_absent: Enter a slug or leave it absent.

public_templates_page_description: Install, activate, and remove Public Templates that replace the Built-in Public Site for visitors.

public_templates_zip_required: Choose a Public Template zip to install.

public_templates_delete_blocked_descript: The Active Public Template cannot be deleted. Deactivate it or activate another installation first.
